entries.en: Training — pop-up targets, no one shooting back. Feel target, approve, fire once.
entries.tw: Ntetee — botaeɛ a ɛpue, obiara ntoo mmra. Hunu botaeɛ, pene so, to prɛko.

entries.en: First time? Start on the turret — targets pop up, you take one shot at a time.
entries.tw: Ɛdi kan? Hyɛ aseɛ wɔ tuo-gyinabea no so — botaeɛ pue, woto prɛko wɔ berɛ biara.

entries.en: locked — clear the stage before it
entries.tw: wɔato mu — wie ɔfa a ɛdi animu no ansa

entries.en: Stand still and hit a thing — feel target, approve, fire.
entries.tw: Gyina faako na bɔ biribi — hunu botaeɛ, pene so, to.

entries.en: The Capitol block — targets pop up, tag each one.
entries.tw: Capitol ɔfa no — botaeɛ pue, hyɛ biara agyiraeɛ.

entries.en: Now it flies — you pilot and aim the drone yourself.
entries.tw: Afei ɛtu — wo ankasa tu drone no na wode kyerɛ.

entries.en: Now two people fly it, and one of them approves every shot.
entries.tw: Afei nnipa baanu tu no, na wɔn mu baako pene tuo biara so.

entries.en: Today: protect the Capital of Texas.
entries.tw: Nnɛ: bɔ Texas Ahenkuro no ho ban.

entries.en: Not automation alone — people, rehearsal, and evidence.
entries.tw: Ɛnyɛ afidie nko ara — nnipa, nsɔhwɛ, ne adanseɛ.

entries.en: Detect: TARGET paints a target amber. Seeing is not deciding.
entries.tw: Hunu: TARGET hyɛ botaeɛ agyiraeɛ akokɔsradeɛ. Ohunu nnyɛ gyinaeɛ.

entries.en: Approve: a second person turns amber to red. AI may spot; a human authorizes.
entries.tw: Pene so: onipa a ɔto so mmienu dane akokɔsradeɛ yɛ kɔkɔɔ. AI bɛtumi ahunu; onipa na ɔma kwan.

entries.en: Engage: FIRE, in the simulation only. The centre scores; off-centre costs.
entries.tw: To: FIRE, wɔ nhwɛsoɔ no mu nko ara. Mfimfini na ɛnya mpɔn; deɛ ɛpa mfimfini no bɔ ka.

entries.en: Recover: the replay shows who saw, who marked, who approved. That is R-CORE.
entries.tw: Sane nya: san-hwɛ no kyerɛ deɛ ɔhunuiɛ, deɛ ɔhyɛɛ agyiraeɛ, deɛ ɔpenee so. Ɛno ne R-CORE.

entries.en: The ladder: CH0 to learn, CH5 under time. The rule never bends.
entries.tw: Atwedeɛ no: CH0 de sua, CH5 wɔ berɛ ase. Mmara no nkoto da.

entries.en: The craft: turret, quad, VTOL foil — one gimbal, one two-step.
entries.tw: Wimhyɛn no: tuo-gyinabea, quad, VTOL foil — gimbal baako, anammɔn-mmienu baako.

entries.en: The crew: 1v1, then 3v3, then 9v9. Scale the crew, not a magazine.
entries.tw: Kuo no: 1v1, afei 3v3, afei 9v9. Ma kuo no nyini, ɛnyɛ atuduro kotokuo.

entries.en: The cities: today the Capital, tomorrow Austin, then Atlantis.
entries.tw: Nkuro no: nnɛ Ahenkuro no, ɔkyena Austin, afei Atlantis.
Adasamma na wɔma kwan. Hyɛ nsɔhwɛ no ase.

entries.tw: DI AGORƆ · KYERƐW · SAN HWƐ · TOTO · FATA · TU MPƆN · KYƐ

entries.tw: nkyekyɛmu baako = WƆAHYƐ AGYIRAEƐ (akokɔsradeɛ) · nkyekyɛmu mmienu = ASIESIE (kɔkɔɔ)
